scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client'); const p = new PrismaClient(); p.$connect().then(async () => { const txs = await p.transaction.findMany(); const selfIds = txs.filter(t => t.senderId === t.receiverId).map(t => t.id); if (selfIds.length > 0) { await p.transaction.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: selfIds } } }); } const negs = await p.user.findMany({ where: { walletBalance: { lt: 0 } } }); for (const u of negs) { await p.user.update({ where: { id: u.id }, data: { walletBalance: 0 } }); } }).catch(console.error).finally(() => p.$disconnect())" && node scripts/seed-settings.js || true
